core_obligations: Set up the presheaf (proof lines 14376-14380): R^q f_*underline M is the sheafification of V |-> H^q_etale(V x_Y X, M).
Decompose for affine V (proof lines 14381-14384): if V is affine then V x_Y X -> X is separated and etale, so by the structure lemma it is a disjoint union of open subschemes U_i of X.

Conclude the vanishing (proof lines 14385-14387): since the local rings of X are strictly henselian the etale cohomology of each U_i equals its Zariski cohomology, which vanishes for q > 0 because U_i is an open of an irreducible scheme and the coefficients are constant.
proof_roadmap: Write the higher direct images as sheafified cohomology over the base changes.
For affine V, split the base change into open subschemes of X.
Use the equality with Zariski cohomology and the vanishing on an irreducible space.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the higher direct images of a constant abelian sheaf along a morphism from an integral normal scheme with separably closed function field all vanish (statement lines 14368-14373). The proof (proof lines 14375-14387) describes the higher direct images as sheafified cohomology over the base change, splits the base change for affine V into open subschemes of X using the structure lemma, and concludes by the equality of etale and Zariski cohomology and the vanishing of the cohomology of a constant sheaf on an irreducible space. H2: one description plus one vanishing input.
